Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a distinguished flying cross license plate.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the creation of a distinguished flying crossaward license plate; adding a new section to chapter 46.04 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 46.16 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.SectionCaption: DISTINGUISHED FLYING CROSS AWARD LICENSE PLATE.
BillSection.RCWSLText: "Distinguishedflying cross award license plate" means a license plate that displaysa depiction of the distinguished flying cross award.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A distinguished flying cross award license plate, as defined insection 1 of this act, is available for purchase by recipients of theaward. Documentation proving recipient status is required for purchase ofthe distinguished flying cross award license plate. This includes: (1) A photocopy of the recipient's honorable discharge, DD214, orrelease from active duty; p. 1 SB 6901 (2) A photocopy of the recipient's current vehicle registration;and (3) A photocopy of any general orders or DD215 amending the DD214granting the award which is needed only if the award is not annotatedon separation documents.
Captions used in this act are notany part of the law.
